summary.name: Wokabulary
summary.one_liner: Wokabulary is a flash card vocabulary learning app for Mac, iPhone and iPad that uses spaced repetition to help users study their own foreign language word lists.
keywords: learn words in a foreign language
use_cases: Memorizing vocabulary for a language class
Building personal vocabulary lists across several languages
summary.what_it_does: Wokabulary lets users enter and manage their own foreign language words, organised into learning levels, with new and difficult words asked more often. It offers several quiz modes: a flash card quiz, a typing quiz for spelling, and a dictation quiz for listening. Users can search words, tag them, mark hard words and synonyms, and track progress with statistics and achievements. Word lists can be imported from the web or shared via AirDrop, and words can be looked up in the macOS and iOS dictionaries or translated with DeepL. The page says data syncs between iPhone, iPad and Mac.
notable: Syncs words and progress between iPhone, iPad and Mac
Multiple quiz modes: flash card, typing and dictation
Automatic sorting into learning levels using spaced repetition
